title: No transform/selection outline drawn when a symbol/MC instance is selected on stage
description:
FIXED. Root cause: the selection-outline render loop in packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx (the per-selected-id loop, else branch ~line 3703) looked up only shapeDisplayObjects, then textDisplayObjects/bitmapDisplayObjects. A selected symbol/MC INSTANCE id is in none of those (instances live in symbolInstanceDisplayObjects and carry no inline width/height), so selectedGenericObj was undefined and the block drew nothing -> no box/handles, even though the instance was selected+draggable (hit-test at ~2536 sets selection state). Groups are shapeDisplayObjects (shape.type==='group') so already covered; only the instance type was missing.

Fix: extended the else branch to also resolve symbolInstanceDisplayObjects and, when the selected id is an instance, compute bounds = getSymbolInstanceBounds(inst, library) (the same AABB the hit-test/snapping/Scale9Grid overlay use, honoring scaleX/scaleY) and draw the same dashed bounding box + 8 resize handles + a rotation handle as a shape. Text/bitmap rendering unchanged. Exported getSymbolInstanceBounds for unit testing.

Verify: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> all packages Done. pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run -> 49 files / 689 tests passed (no failures; the documented ~3 task-1207 fixture failures are not present in the current tree). New test packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/instanceSelectionOutline.test.ts (5 tests) asserts getSymbolInstanceBounds returns non-zero scaled bounds and that the render-branch lookup chain now resolves an instance id to a drawable box (pre-fix: undefined).
